description: Lay one finished video out in another size, the same video cut for that frame, as the app's Other sizes does. Free. Only for a video whose after_steps lists other_sizes, in a size it lists. Answers an id at once: call get_video with it, or get_product_video for a product video's, every few seconds until its status is ready or failed. The same size asked again answers the one already made or being made.

id.description: The id of a finished video, from make_video, list_videos or make_product_video.

size.description: The size to lay it out in, one after_steps lists.

name: other_sizes
title: Another size
